item.description: The film-maker enjoyed a long and varied film and TV career, from horror movies and true-crime thrillers to Cannibal and Breaking Bad Peter Medak, the British-Hungarian director of The Changeling, The Krays and Let Him Have It, has died aged 88. Medak’s family announced he died peacefully in Los Angeles on Tuesday. Medak enjoyed a long and varied career across film and TV, which included spirit-of-the-times classics A Day in the Death of Joe Egg and The Ruling Class (both from 1972), cult horror The Changeling with George C Scott, and The Krays and Let Him Have It, period true crime films… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

Desde su constitución, el 26 de enero de 2021, este laboratorio de inteligencia artificial (IA) está registrado como una PBC ( Public Benefit Corporation o Corporación de Beneficio Público). Esta declaración de intenciones significa que sus administradores tienen la obligación de equilibrar los intereses económicos de los accionistas con los de las personas afectadas por la actividad de la empresa. item.title: Islands harbor nearly 20% of Earth's biodiversity, yet remain overlooked in conservation strategies
item.description: Although they account for just 7% of the Earth's land surface, island ecosystems harbor almost 20% of the world's biodiversity. From sea-level rise to biological invasions, islands are facing multiple pressures associated with ongoing global change, and yet they are still overlooked in global biodiversity conservation strategies. Fuente: Phys.org.
